_doc: The hunter's kit (docs/hvf-PLAN.md §7). Read by js/sim/modes/hvf/hunter.js. Skills by `cast` slot; `level` = the hunter level that unlocks it. spear: thrown automatically at a target out of melee reach within `range` (cooldown). lodge: command `lodge {x, z}`, cost, build seconds, at most `max` standing including the kennel; a lodge is a respawn point, a shop and `sight` m of vision. watchstone/snare: placed things farmers can pull up. tracking: from `level` the hunter sees stray tracks.
